notes.title: New Island is coming! - The Stardust Island
notes.content:
Greetings adventurers!

It's been a while since the last post, since I've been more or less gathering feedback from all over the place to address the right things in the coming updates.

Fortunately, I've been able to get a lot of good insights what should I focus on the game. I'll explain the most important aspects below:

[h3]ONBOARDING:[/h3]
Currently people find it rather hard to 'get into the game'. There are multiple reasons for that, but the biggest seems to be the rather harsh learning curve and confusing controls. People who discovered the controls, have enjoyed the game fully. But the biggest barrier for new people to start liking the game, is because of the confusing controls. This will be addressed within the coming update.

[h3]A WAY TO DELETE SEEKERS[/h3]
The most hardcore players have encountered an unexpected issue of having too much of Seekers on their list. There are way too many Seekers and it's hard to stay track that which of the Seekers is which. And also, there are too many Seekers on peoples roster, which they don't even need anymore. I'll make a feature within the coming update, where you can delete the "unnecessary" Seekers for additional rewards. Most likely, this will be a separate building for the village.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44088802/387ec40044a51f22b5440a44b04729b9ac6b9207.png[/img]

[h3]MORE WAYS TO USE MONEY[/h3]
People have a lot of money and have already unlocked all the heroes available. I will be adding another feature within the game to spend that well-earned money. This will be as an example: Artifacts, items and keys.

[h3]LACK OF CONTENT[/h3]
This is very obvious, since there is currently only one island within the game. In the next update, I will reveal the Stardust Island! Most likely the boss fight will come a little later, but most of the levels will be there!


[h2]BUT HERE COMES THE MOST IMPORTANT THING:[/h2]

Please play the game right now and share your feedback what would you like to see within the game! I would love to address those within the coming update(s) as well! <3

Remember to join our Discord for further discussions: [url=https://discord.gg/Cb9hY8y]https://discord.gg/Cb9hY8y[/url]

notes.title: Roadmap Released - Seeker: Quest Future Plans
notes.content:
Happy Holidays everyone!

[b]I wanted to share a ”Roadmap” [/b]of things I’m planning on either testing, or adding into Seeker: Quest within the coming months. I’m going to have a week of vacation starting from today, but after that here are the things my main focus are:

[h2]Full Controller Support[/h2]
I want to have the game accessible to controllers much, much better. The current system is not something I’m very proud of. Not with it’s controls, tutorials or anything related. Also the code structure will need some refactoring to do it well once and for all.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44088802/1243261fdccd975337b13702b2893f39b0ec4403.png[/img]

[h2]Steam Achievements[/h2]
A lot of people have been asking for Steam Achievements so I will add those as soon as possible!

[h2]The Evolution Chamber Building[/h2]
There are already a good amount of users who have collected so much of Seekers that the list is full. (How awesome is that?) So now we need some new features to ”delete” the characters. Because just plain deleting wouldn’t be fun, I want to add an ”Evolution Chamber” building into the game, which allows you to combine the Seekers into a new evolution level. There will be some amount of combinations from the beginning, but this will also be a feature I’ll develop further during the Early Access period. 

[h2]Abyss Portal Building[/h2]
To address the issue of having too many Seekers, I want to add functionality to just delete them also. But with a reward! With the Abyss portal you’ll be able to send the Seekers through the portal as a ”gift for the lord of the Abyss”. By doing so, you’ll get a reward in exchange. You will lose the gifted Seeker, but get some fun items you wouldn’t get otherwise. These will include some unique abilities and other artifacts.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44088802/a32a41834bd69d034e544c750531a14cd2d62d85.png[/img]

[h2]PvP and Leaderboards![/h2]
I’ve been dreaming of having some sort of way in competing with other players. The current plan is to add a seasonal island, in which you collect points. With these points you’ll compete against other players and get rewards. (Such as new Seekers) This feature is still in planning phase, so it will take a moment to get it implemented.

[h2]New Island: Stardust Island[/h2]
As there will be a total of three islands, the ”Stardust” island will be the second one. Featuring its own new Seekers to collect, but also to continue the story and fight the second boss!

[h2]New Island: Spirit Island[/h2]
The third island will be the Spirit island. Yet again to continue the story of the game and have the third boss fight available! (Not to forget the new Seeker encounters!)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44088802/9895a5f91cdaf0e003570b85558eabc66cebde44.png[/img]

[h2]Final Boss[/h2]
The Leerking will eventually come into the game, which will feature the ending of the story. Once the Leerking is finalized, the Seeker: Quest can be considered as ready for the 1.0 release!

I hope you like these new upcoming features and be sure to [url=https://discord.gg/Cb9hY8y]jump into our Discord[/url] for further discussions!

[h3]PS: Remember to leave a review for Seeker: Quest! With the reviews a lot of more people are able to see the game on their storefront! <3[/h3]

Happy Christmas to everyone and the most awesome new year. The year 2025 will be one to remember! <3

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44088802/82e71d0ffe0b3b3a525b82e440f2c708afab432e.png[/img]

All the best,
Klaus, The Jester
Jestercraft

notes.title: GIANTS & POOPLETS: Season Update - Seeker: Quest
notes.content:
Greetings everyone!

The Christmas season is here and we are prepared. The "Poppy" Seeker has established his very own island into Seeker: Quest and you're able to obtain him as a playable character. 

Poppy will be removed from the game on January, but if you're able to catch & hatch him before that, his forever yours! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44088802/499f9cb242f85235ec487dcb9da4dd66f00f7ba8.png[/img]

But as always, that won't be an easy task. The "Poppy's Paradise" level is guarded by not only waves of Seekers, but the new Seeker "Giants". The level is best suited for a good Seeker roster, so prepare your team before jumping into the Poppy's Paradise level.

The Giants are here to stay. Functionality is rather simple: Any of the spawning enemy Seekers can become a "Giant" which means it has more power, more speed, more health and... You guessed it. More loot!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44088802/2c05cda597e7e4b310274d03865f7461c1c31d65.png[/img]

There is also two new unique abilities added into the Treasure Chest loot. "Pooplet Drop" and the "Lootbag". 

Plus not to mention the various amount of bug fixes and polishing!

Now would be a good time to jump in and start preparing your roster for the Poppy's Paradise for some crazy time! 

Remember to join our [url=https://discord.gg/Cb9hY8y]Discord channel[/url] for further discussions and to offer your valuable feedback. 

I also post weekly content to my [url=https://www.youtube.com/@jestercrafts]Youtube channel,[/url] if you're interested in following the journey of an independent solo game developer. It's harsh, I know. But at least I'm sharing my progress as transparent as possible!

See you in flower fields of [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2300100/Seeker_Quest/]Seeker: Quest! (Steam Page)[/url]

All the best,
Klaus
The Jester

notes.title: Patch v0.47 (Patch notes) - Risky update before launch
notes.content:

I like living on the edge. This time I'm doing it by releasing an update couple of hours before the release. I just had to do it. I got the "Mini Bosses" feature functioning (as it seems) and also some bug fixes, which I wanted to address.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2300100/Seeker_Quest/]Seeker: Quest Steam Store Page[/url]

[b]Please note that the controller is kind of supported now. But for best gaming experience, I suggest using keyboard only. You may encounter some funny stuff within the user interface, if even having a controller plugged in. [/b]

- Added round range indicator to characters (Easier to see how far you can strike)
- Added randomly spawning "Mini Bosses" - There is a 5% chance that any enemy that spawns is a "Mini Boss" - which has high attributes and deals massive damage. It also glows.
- Enemy Kabook Detonation was dealing flat damage, it should now scale depending on it's level and elements
- Mughi had lost it's vision and was no longer chasing the player, instead, running around aimlessly. Should now have its vision back.
- Dart was dealing flat damage on rocket hit. Should now be fixed to deal damage accordining his own damage. (Before was flat 50)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44088802/991c67b414adff5da2276c703d28b7ca7d645ee9.png[/img]

Come join our [url=https://discord.gg/Cb9hY8y]Discord channel [/url]for further discussions!

PS:
If you want to check out my Youtube video I just uploaded, where I reflect the thoughts of the upcoming release, you can see it [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=YBFrw-qsrwI&t]HERE.[/url]

notes.title: Meet the Seekers - The Seekers of Seeker: Quest
notes.content:
[h1]🐾 Meet the Seekers in [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2300100/Seeker_Quest/][u]Seeker: Quest[/u][/url]! 🐾[/h1]

In [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2300100/Seeker_Quest/][u]Seeker: Quest[/u][/url], every character you encounter in the wild could join your team—or stand in your way. Each Seeker is fully playable, with their own unique abilities, attributes, and quirks. Building your team isn’t just strategy—it’s about creating a squad that feels just right for your adventure.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44088802/991c67b414adff5da2276c703d28b7ca7d645ee9.png[/img]

[h2]🎮 Gameplay Highlights[/h2][list]  [*][b]Pick Your Team:[/b] Start your journey by choosing three Seekers to form your team.[/*]  [*][b]Seamless Seeker Switching:[/b] Press [b]W[/b] mid-battle to pause the game and select the best Seeker for the situation. Take your time—strategize, plan, and jump back into the action when you’re ready.[/*]  [*][b]Abilities That Matter:[/b] Each Seeker has attributes, a passive ability (coming in Big Update #1), and a unique Active ability to turn the tide of battle.[/*][/list]
It’s a cozy mix of action and strategy that lets you play at your own pace while still keeping things exciting!

[h2]🦸 Your First Hero and Seeker[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44088802/1243261fdccd975337b13702b2893f39b0ec4403.png[/img]

At the start of [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2300100/Seeker_Quest/][u]Seeker: Quest[/u][/url], you’ll choose a hero and their paired Seeker to kick off your journey. Think Pokémon, but without the professor—the first Seeker comes with your chosen Hero.
[list]  [*][b]Hero: Draven, Seeker: Batterim[/b]
  Batterim is your tank, taking hits and dealing them right back with his Sylvan Orb, a circling bullet storm. He’s a bit of a know-it-all, but you’ll appreciate his reliability.[/*]  [*][b]Hero: Nama’Ghal, Seeker: Grub[/b]
  Grub might be slimy and smelly, but his Poison Trail leaves a cloud of damage for enemies. He’s not big on personality—think full-grown vegetable levels of charm—but he’s undeniably effective.[/*]  [*][b]Hero: Azrael, Seeker: Shaola[/b]
  Shaola’s calm and spiritual nature belies his strength. His Spiritual Ground ability heals allies and damages enemies, making him a quiet but powerful force in battle.[/*][/list][h2]🌟 Discover More Seekers![/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44088802/93a55020cf3d15fc5c2ce498068c3f0d7d536e3f.png[/img]

Batterim, Grub, and Shaola are just the beginning. As you explore Naturia, you’ll encounter even more Seekers to add to your roster, including:
[list]  [*][b]Isegon:[/b] A frost guardian who chills enemies to the bone.[/*]  [*][b]Flox:[/b] Fast and fiery with an explosive personality.[/*]  [*][b]Kabook:[/b] A bomb-like Seeker that delivers high-risk, high-reward damage.[/*]  [*]And maybe even... the legendary Leerking?![/*][/list]
Each new Seeker adds to the cozy-yet-chaotic fun of building your ultimate team.
[h2]🗺️ Ready to Explore Naturia?[/h2]

Are you prepared to meet unforgettable characters, build your dream squad, and immerse yourself in a world of strategy, adventure, and charm? Jump in, get cozy, and show Naturia what Seekers are made of!

🎉 [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2300100/Seeker_Quest/]Add [u]Seeker: Quest[/u] to your Steam Wishlist[/url] and be the first to know about updates!

🫂 [url=https://discord.gg/Cb9hY8y]Join our cozy community on Discord[/url] to share your thoughts, find friends, and stay up-to-date!

notes.title: What to Expect in Seeker: Quest Early Access
notes.content:
[h3]Seeker: Quest Early Access Release Date: December 12, 2024[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44088802/639a1c16048ae3ffa913dee18044708cbd25ba34.png[/img]

Now that we’ve revealed the Early Access release date ([url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2300100/view/4476110102203468327]within our latest announcement[/url]), let's dive into what [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2300100/Seeker_Quest/]Seeker: Quest[/url] will offer from day one!

[h2]New Seekers[/h2]
There will be dozens of collectible and playable characters added regularly, each with unique abilities and attributes. Some will even join your team as enemies first, making the hunt for them even more exciting!

When we go live with the Early Access,  there will be around 20 Seekers you can challenge and eventually unlock! (By the way, we are arranging some Seeker designing competitions on our [url=https://discord.gg/Cb9hY8y]Discord[/url]. Be sure to join!)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44088802/a32a41834bd69d034e544c750531a14cd2d62d85.png[/img]

[h2]New Levels & Challenges[/h2]
The first island is ready for you to explore, but more islands and challenging content will come with Big Updates. The first "Big Update" will introduce a second island, and so on.

On each of these "Big Updates" I try to bring in as much content as possible for you to enjoy on one sitting (or maybe multiple?). So in case you decide to jump into the early access from day 1, there will be almost monthly updates for you to come back and enjoy once you've completed the previous content.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44088802/9895a5f91cdaf0e003570b85558eabc66cebde44.png[/img]

[h2]Story & Dialogue[/h2]
The main character, Ive, leads the rebellion with her crew of exiled warrior, Draven. The warmongering and hate driven Sylvan Mage, Azrael and the nature loving potion crafter, Naman'Ghal. Within the first "chapter" aka. Early Access release, the story will include journey towards the discovery of the "Leer Temple" and what it is for.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44088802/cda3950b66ea21cf2d6c8dc85d4c95261d37a7c9.png[/img]

Expect tons of dialogue updates and story expansion as we add more islands and deepen the characters’ backgrounds.

Are you ready to dive in? Be sure to [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2300100/Seeker_Quest/]wishlist Seeker: Quest[/url] and keep an eye on the announcements on our [url=https://discord.gg/Cb9hY8y]Discord channel. [/url]

The adventure begins soon!

notes.title: New Patch (08/12/23) - More speed! | LAST PATCH BEFORE CLOSING THE DEMO
notes.content:
Greetings adventurers!

I've just rolled out a new patch which adds some "quality of life" -things for the demo, but also some balancing for character speeds, damages and more. There is also a new version for the targeting system in place now! I've decided to change it a little, to be more clear who you are currently targeting at.

I also noticed one bug just before going live with the patch, but decided to fix it a little later: Some of the keybinds show controller binds in the UI, even though there is no controller plugged. In most of the cases, the keyboard control is "Q" rather than "B", what the UI suggests.

PLEASE NOTE: This is the LAST PATCH I'll do before closing down the demo. I'll keep the demo available for download for a couple of weeks now and then close it for good. Hope to see you trying the game!

Be sure to join our [url=https://discord.gg/Cb9hY8y]Discord [/url]and follow me on [url=https://www.instagram.com/jestercraft/]Instagram[/url]!

Best regards,
Klaus, The Jester

notes.title: Seeker: Quest Demo MAJOR PATCH #2
notes.content:
Hello, Adventurers!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44088802/00caea970870bc22ab1ea0f3d3225e943d930b31.png[/img]

It's time for another [b]MAJOR UPDATE![/b] The patch contains numerous changes, fixes, additions, and even new features. Check out the patch notes below:

[list]
[*] Hero selection: You can now choose a hero from three exiled Jesterians: Draven, Azrael, and Nama'Ghal.
[*] Each hero features three different 'Hero Cards' that can be used during levels.
[*] Several new Seekers to battle against and capture, each with their unique abilities.
[*] Bullet system: Each Seeker has a set amount of bullets that regenerate over time (depending on the cooldown stat of that Seeker).
[*] A story trailer has been added at the beginning of the game (Can be skipped with ESC).
[*] Modified all Seeker stats.
[/list]

[b]KNOWN BUGS[/b] (Fixes coming soon)
[list]
[*] If two or more Seekers gain a level up at the same time, the game may "freeze." If this occurs, the game needs to be restarted.
[*] The Boulder trap behaves strangely at times (gets stuck in places where it shouldn't).
[*] Currently, the player can move in the Village before the dialogues start, which may cause a "strange feeling" for some players (as they get interrupted by the dialogue suddenly).
[/list]

Be sure to play the Seeker: Quest Demo and check out the new story trailer on [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4H-DEkzp2hw]Youtube [/url]

And why not [url=https://discord.gg/Cb9hY8y]join our Discord[/url] for further discussions of the game!

Happy adventuring!

Best wishes,
Klaus, The Jester
Jestercraft

notes.title: Seeker: Quest Big Demo Update NOW LIVE!
notes.content:
Greetings adventurers!

The day has finally come! After long nights and a lot of bug squashing I've managed to get a big update for Seeker: Quest demo on Steam. 

[previewyoutube=qj_2CWHv1j4;full][/previewyoutube]

This Seeker game demo will work as the building base for me to polish the demo content to as good condition as I possibly can before the Steam Next Fest which is happening at the start of next month. (October 9th 2023)

The demo features at least the following features/elements:
- 3 levels
- 1 boss fight
- Multiple stat items to boost your Seekers
- Two buildings to unlock
- 6 unlockable seekers

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44088802/321ba5443658ffff94282c7fa4d00b6717c543aa.png[/img]
Showcase of Batterim Character

Since Seeker Quest is the first game I've ever programmed 100% solo, it's been a very demanding, but educating project so far. Naturally, there is still a lot to do with the game but with this demo update I actually managed to cut down features, ease the work load and focus on delivering better quality for the existing features.

In case you're sitting on your PC at this moment, you can play the updated [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2300100/Seeker_Quest/]Seeker Quest Demo on Steam right now.[/url]

The Steam Next Fest 2023 will be a big event for the Seeker Quest but also for the whole Seeker Universe. I'm trying my best to share the word of my on-going and let people know, that the Seeker world is much more than "just a game". For me, the story is the biggest thing which I want to share in different medias. In case you're interested in knowing more about the Seeker Universe story, you're welcome to join our [url=https://www.patreon.com/Jestercraft959]Patreon[/url] or [url=https://www.instagram.com/jestercraft/]Instagram[/url]!

notes.title: Dungeon crawling and monster catching - Seeker: Quest Demo now available
notes.content:
[h3]Greetings adventurers![/h3]

Seeker: Quest Demo is now available for free to play on Steam! The early preview demo version features twelve maps to discover and hunt for new Seeker species to catch and hatch. As a cherry on the top, you can already try out the Leer Norzu boss fight (Yes, it's an electric elephant) which is one of the many bosses you'll challenge within coming months.

[h3]Why we released development version as a demo on Steam? [/h3]

We found out that the Steam Demo is the best method to get everyone on board testing the game while we add more content. The Steam Playtest will remain as a separate release, where we try out even more strange stuff before going live on the "Demo branch". 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44088802/12358c33d87c7465d03a4d13a19e716020cfff64.png[/img]

[h3]Within the Seeker: Quest Demo you can[/h3]

- Collect multiple different (playable) Seeker characters
- Obtain different foods to boost your character stats (permanently)
- Discover the hand-drawn artstyle within twelve levels
- Survive through traps and other environmental hazards on your journeys
- Obtain building resources (Stars) to reinforce your village (Currently features 2 buildings)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44088802/0859be9165ce86772d4f289e8c8e0160e6fa0319.png[/img]

You can expect more content to be added within coming weeks and months while we approach the early access of Seeker: Quest!

If you're interested in helping us develop the game, be sure to join our [url=https://discord.gg/Cb9hY8y]Discord[/url] channel or support us on our [url=https://www.patreon.com/Jestercraft959]Patreon[/url].

Best wishes,
Team Jestercraft

notes.title: Seeker: Quest Playtest is now available!
notes.content:
Greetings adventurers!

The Seeker: Quest Playtest is now released and you can signup to the testing phase from our store page. We would love to see you on board testing the very first alpha release of our action adventure game!

There is still a long road head of us to finalize the game, but we feel that this is a huge step for the games development to get the most important aspect involved: You. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44088802/483f6170fc1daa400ef1ca75d5b0f53648abc34e.png[/img]

Be sure to join our [url=https://discord.gg/Cb9hY8y]DISCORD[/url] channel to plan, discuss and throw out ideas how we should continue the development. [b]Our next steps for the game updates are:[/b]

[b]Get the demo release ready[/b]
[list]
[*] First boss fight
[*] [i]Add more content (More enemies, more characters, more abilities, spirits, items...)[/i]
[*] Continue the story
[*] More buildings available [i](ex. Town Hall which features multiple playable heroes)[/i]
[*] Polish [i](Add missing sound effects, music, other effects, etc..)[/i]
[/list]

We hope to see you playing the game and stay onboard for future updates as well!

Happy weekend for you all!

-Team Jestercraft
